description.content: Returns coretime chain status information including the last committed timeslice.

Returns all regions on a coretime chain including begin/end timeslices, core, owner, and mask.
Returns potential renewals on a coretime chain sorted by core index, including price, completion status, and task assignment.
Returns all reservations on a coretime chain. Reserved cores are permanently allocated and not available for sale.
Returns paginated coretime assignment records filtered by paraId and core.
Returns a paginated list of broker operation events filtered by address, core, core index, event ID, and block range.
Returns paginated purchased coretime regions with optional cycle, core, and purchase-type filters.
Returns detailed information for a coretime region by core_index.
Returns paginated coretime regions filtered by owner, lifecycle status, and block boundaries.
Returns coretime sale information filtered by region begin and sales cycle.
Returns paginated historical coretime sale records.
Returns workload details for a region and requires either core or para_id.
Returns paginated workload history and requires either core or para_id.
Returns paginated workload summaries for the latest or specified region.
Returns paginated coretime workplan records filtered by paraId and core.
